options.name: dnac_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: dnac_password
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center password to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_username
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center username to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: dnac_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco DNA Center to use.

options.name: id
options.description: Id path parameter. The id of the discovery.

options.name: managementIpSelectionMethod
options.description: When Catalyst Center discovers a device, it uses one of the device's IP addresses as the preferred management IP address for the device. The IP address can be that of a built-in management interface of the device, another physical interface, or a logical interface like Loopback0. You can configure Catalyst Center to log the device's loopback IP address as the preferred management IP address, provided the IP address is reachable from Catalyst Center.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the discovery job being created. This will be a unique name.

options.name: onlyNewDevice
options.description: This flag indicates to discover only new devices that are not in inventory. If set to true, only devices that are not in the inventory will be discovered. If set to false, devices that already exist in the inventory will not be listed in the discovered devices list.

options.name: updateManagementIp
options.description: This flag indicates if the management IP address of existing devices to be updated as part of this discovery. If set false devices get discovered with the existing management IP address. If set true it overwrites the management IP address with the new IP address used in discovery.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
